name: Proposals for decisions
title: SECOND REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union agencies for the financial year 2023
part_text:
The European Parliament approves the 2023 spending of the European Union Agency for Asylum and closes its accounts. It had delayed this decision in May 2025. The report also asks the agency to fix serious problems found by the European Anti-Fraud Office: weak handling of conflicts of interest, flawed staff recruitment, and poor oversight by its management board. It asks for faster fraud investigations, public summaries of the findings, and better protection for staff who report wrongdoing.

- The agency's 2023 budget is formally approved and its accounts closed.
- The agency must fix recruitment, conflicts of interest and oversight, and report back.
- Parliament may withhold future approval if reforms are not delivered.
